utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we already set the date for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet — I think we were still narrowing it down. I can check with the folks organizing it when I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks. Can you ask them which date works best?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus—just the basics, really. I might have missed the details, but if you’ve got a hammer and a screwdriver, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ve got both, and I can bring them by for you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is starting soon — folks are gathering tools and making a list of what needs fixing. I can ask around if you want the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help, thanks — I’m a little worried about what needs to be brought and where everything’s getting dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around and see what they want brought, then I’ll let you know the drop-off spot too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you check the hardware store on Pine and the community center bulletin board for any repair-drive flyers? If you spot anything, just let me know where and when.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check both spots and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and make sure folks know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I really appreciate you helping get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll let everyone on the block know. If you want, I can also help gather a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. What’s the first item you want to tackle, Leo?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s start with the broken fence panel by the alley. I can help haul materials if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — that fence panel is a great first fix. I’ll line up the materials and let you know when we’re ready to haul.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs fixing for the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mostly the leaky faucet, the loose porch step, and that flickering hallway light. I usually show up late, but I can help with whichever one you need most.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ve got the leaky faucet, loose porch step, and flickering hallway light. If you’re running late, I’ll start with the faucet and we can take the others as we go.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that — what time window are we aiming for around the school schedule?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: After school works best for me, maybe 3:30 to 5:00, so folks can swing by once pickup’s done.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I’ll plan around 3:30 to 5:00 and make sure it fits the pickup rush.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon—Jules, do you know what they still need? I’ve mostly just gotten bits and pieces from other neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think they still need volunteers, a few tools, and some donated supplies. I can check the latest list and let you know exactly what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks—I'm still only hearing scraps from people around the block.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what’s the repair drive need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming—you’re still able to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still in. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What’s the next thing you need fixed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Rey. I think the porch light by the front steps is the next thing we need fixed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take a look at the porch light first thing. If you’ve got the bulb or ladder handy, I’ll get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive, and I’ll keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supply list and let you know if we’re short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating the plan to folks so everyone stays in the loop. Just let me know if anything changes on the supply list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s getting organized nicely—what do you need me to pass along?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Could you let folks know we still need a few extra hands for the heavier repairs? I can help coordinate if anyone has tools or a free hour.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely—I’ll pass that along and mention tools or even just an hour would help a lot. Anything specific you want me to tell folks to bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help if you tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’m still sorting the details, but I’ll let you know what’s needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — just give me a shout when you’ve got the list, and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might've missed the details, but I’m in if you need help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Noah — that helps a lot. I’ll send the details and what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo — just send me the details when you can, and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand if you need tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll keep it simple: I’ll bring a list of what’s needed, and we can go from there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — bring the list by when you’ve got it, and I’ll see what I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—just tell me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Wonderful, Mara—thank you! I’ll put you down to help on Saturday morning, and I’ll send the details right over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Quinn—I’ll be there Saturday morning. Send the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal — the repair drive sounds like a great way to get everyone helping out together. Want me to spread the word to the other folks I know?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be wonderful, Jules — thank you. Please let them know we’re meeting at the repair drive spot on Maple Street this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll let everyone know to meet at the repair drive spot on Maple Street this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m getting the repair drive organized now. If you’ve got any items or know a neighbor who needs help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Rosa — I can send over a few tools and some screws, and I’ll ask around to see who needs help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, thank you, Cleo — the tools and screws will help a lot. And I’d really appreciate you asking around; I’ll keep everything sorted on my end.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming up soon—are they still collecting tools and donations?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yep, they are—tools, spare parts, and cash donations are all still being accepted. Want me to check what they need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—I'd really appreciate that. I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so knowing what they need most would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you help by sorting the donations and keeping an eye on the sign-in table? I’ll handle the school schedule side and make sure we don’t overlap pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can do that. I’ll sort the donations and keep watch at the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, can you help sort the repair items and keep track of donations?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can do that. I’ll sort the repair items and keep track of the donations.
